name: etcd
description: three-member etcd cluster; acked puts survive, client revisions never go back, members agree.

text./etc/etcd-member:
# etcd-member <n> <addr> <client-port> <peer-port>: member n as user etcd<n>. exec all the
# way down, so the service's PID is etcd itself (kills and pauses hit etcd).
exec su etcd$1 -s /bin/sh -c "exec /bin/etcd --name etcd$1 --data-dir /data/etcd$1 \
  --listen-client-urls http://$2:$3 --advertise-client-urls http://$2:$3 \
  --listen-peer-urls http://$2:$4 --initial-advertise-peer-urls http://$2:$4 \
  --initial-cluster $ETCD_CLUSTER --initial-cluster-token hydo --initial-cluster-state new \
  --log-level warn"

shell:
ectl() { /bin/etcdctl --dial-timeout=1s --command-timeout=2s "$@"; }
ep_of() { case $1 in 0) echo 127.0.0.11:2379;; 1) echo 127.0.0.12:12379;; *) echo 127.0.0.13:22379;; esac; }
rev_of() { printf '%s' "$1" | sed -n 's/.*"header":{[^}]*"revision":\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p'; }
member_setup() {   # <n> <addr>: data dir owned by etcd<n>; uid 100<n> sends from <addr>
  mkdir -p /data/etcd$1 && chown etcd$1:etcd$1 /data/etcd$1 && chmod 700 /data/etcd$1 || return 1
  # the local table moves from rule 0 to rule 100, so the per-uid rules (pref 10) come first
  $IPR rule show | grep -q '^100:.*lookup local' || { $IPR rule add pref 100 lookup local && $IPR rule del pref 0; } || return 1
  $IPR route show table 10$1 | grep -q "src $2" || $IPR route add local 127.0.0.0/8 dev lo src $2 table 10$1 || return 1
  $IPR rule show | grep -q "uidrange 100$1-100$1" || $IPR rule add pref 10 uidrange 100$1-100$1 lookup 10$1
}
wait_quorum() {   # up to 60 s for a linearizable read through any member
  local n=0
  until ectl --endpoints=$EPS get hydo-probe > /dev/null 2>&1; do
    n=$((n + 1)); [ $n -lt 60 ] || return 1; sleep 1
  done
}
observe() {   # <client> <revision> <what>: log it; a revision below this client's last one is a
              # violation, reported at once (a power cut would lose the log before the final check)
  local f=/tmp/hydo/rev.$1 last
  last=$(tail -1 $f 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1)
  if [ -n "$last" ] && [ "$2" -lt "$last" ]; then
    echo "HYDO-ASSERT {\"t\":\"always\",\"id\":\"client.revisions_monotonic\",\"ok\":false,\"msg\":\"each client's observed revisions never go backwards\",\"details\":{\"out\":\"client $1 saw revision $2 ($3) after $last\"}}" > /dev/console
  fi
  echo "$2 $3" >> $f
}
client_op() {   # <client> <step>: put k<id>=v<id>, then read it back, through one member
  local c=$1 id ep out r
  id=$(($2 * 3 + $1)); ep=$(ep_of $((($1 + $2) % 3)))
  if out=$(ectl --endpoints=$ep -w json put k$id v$id 2>/dev/null) && r=$(rev_of "$out") && [ -n "$r" ]; then
    echo $id >> $HYDO_ACKED; echo "$id ack" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES; observe $c $r put-k$id@$ep
  else
    echo "$id unknown" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES
  fi
  out=$(ectl --endpoints=$ep -w json get k$id 2>/dev/null) && r=$(rev_of "$out") && [ -n "$r" ] && observe $c $r get-k$id@$ep
  return 0
}

workload.run:
i=$HYDO_FROM
while [ $i -lt $HYDO_TO ]; do
  client_op 0 $i & client_op 1 $i & client_op 2 $i &
  wait
  if [ $((i % 5)) = 4 ]; then     # a write, then at once an online defrag of every member
    ectl --endpoints=$EPS put hydo-defrag $i > /dev/null 2>&1
    /bin/etcdctl --dial-timeout=1s --command-timeout=5s --endpoints=$EPS defrag > /dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
done
workload.retry:
wait_quorum || exit 0
i=0
while [ $i -lt $((HYDO_STEPS * 3)) ]; do
  if ! grep -qx $i $HYDO_ACKED; then
    for a in 1 2 3; do       # a fresh leader may still refuse the first attempt
      ectl --endpoints=$EPS put k$i v$i > /dev/null 2>&1 && { echo $i >> $HYDO_ACKED; echo "$i ack" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES; break; }
      sleep 1
    done
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
done

invariants.msg: every put a client saw acknowledged is readable with its value after recovery
each client's observed revisions never go backwards
invariants.cmd:
n=0
for f in /tmp/hydo/rev.0 /tmp/hydo/rev.1 /tmp/hydo/rev.2; do
  [ -f $f ] || continue
  n=$((n + $(wc -l < $f)))
  awk -v f=$f '$1 < last { print f ": revision " $1 " (" $2 ") after " last " (" what ")"; exit 1 } { last = $1; what = $2 }' $f || exit 1
done
echo "observations=$n monotonic"

invariants.msg: after the run every member reports the same revision and the same mod_revision of the last acked key
invariants.cmd:
wait_quorum || { echo "no quorum within 60 s"; exit 2; }
last=$(sort -n $HYDO_ACKED | tail -1); key=k$last
[ -n "$last" ] || key=hydo-probe
n=0
while :; do
  rs=""; ms=""; ok=1
  for m in 0 1 2; do
    r=$(rev_of "$(ectl --endpoints=$(ep_of $m) -w json endpoint status 2>/dev/null)")
    mr=$(ectl --endpoints=$(ep_of $m) --consistency=s -w json get $key 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*"mod_revision":\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
    [ -n "$r" ] && [ -n "$mr" ] || ok=0
    rs="$rs $r"; ms="$ms $mr"
  done
  if [ $ok = 1 ] && [ $(echo $rs | tr ' ' '\n' | sort -u | wc -l) = 1 ] && [ $(echo $ms | tr ' ' '\n' | sort -u | wc -l) = 1 ]; then
    echo "members agree: revision$rs, $key mod_revision$ms"; exit 0
  fi
  n=$((n + 1)); [ $n -lt 30 ] || break
  sleep 1
done
[ $ok = 1 ] || { echo "a member did not answer within 30 s (revisions$rs; $key mod_revisions$ms)"; exit 2; }
echo "members disagree: revisions$rs; $key mod_revisions$ms"; exit 1
